notes: A082235_conjecture_false (A082235_mathlib.lean): for every sequence a with a 1 = 1, a(n+1) > 0 and concat(a n, a(n+1)) triangular (n >= 1), concat(a n, a(n+1)) is never 1, 21, 28, 45, 78 or 91; excluded_are_triangular. So the conjecture (every triangular number except 3, 6, 10 is a member of A082235) is false. Outside Lean: none (existence of the greedy sequence is not needed).
